sentences.text: The genus Rhacheosaurus was established by Christian Erich Hermann von Meyer in 1831 based on skeletal remains from the Late Jurassic of Germany.
Researchers suggest that the lightly built Rhacheosaurus may have specialized in feeding on small prey, while other long-snouted relatives fed mostly on fish.
A 2009 phylogenetic analysis showed that several long-snouted species previously placed in Geosaurus, Enaliosuchus, and Metriorhynchus were reclassified into Rhacheosaurus.
Rhacheosaurus fossils come from the Tithonian stage of the Late Jurassic period in Germany.
This animal lived between 149.2 and 145.06 million years ago during the Tithonian stage.
It is debated whether niche partitioning allowed several species of crocodyliforms to coexist in the same environment.
